skill_card.name: Skill Creator Skill
skill_card.description: Autonomous, deterministic Agent Skill creator. Generates complete Spec 1.0 compliant skills from user requirements, creates a task-based testing.md checklist, orchestrates user confirmation for test cases, produces evals.json, and evaluates the skill using evaluator-skill.

tasks.name: Scaffold Spec 1.0 Skill Structure
tasks.description: Creates standardized directory layout, SKILL.md, Python script engine, references, and manifest.
tasks.input_schema: Skill name, description, and SDLC phase.
tasks.output_schema: Fully scaffolded skill folder matching enterprise architecture.

tasks.name: Generate Task-Based Testing Plan
tasks.description: Emits testing.md containing unit test instructions, E2E test scenarios, and user verification checklist.

tasks.name: Orchestrate Test Synthesis and Quality Evaluation
tasks.description: Writes evals/evals.json and invokes evaluator-skill to verify quality and AST security scorecards.
tasks.output_schema: evals/evals.json and comprehensive quality scorecard report.
